entities.name: Torya Longshanks
entities.description: Farmer turned soldier during Terisiare's Dark Age who ended the curse on King Rogan.

entities.name: Rogan
entities.description: King of Angremur cursed to become a monster each night.

entities.name: Angremur
entities.description: City whose citadel Torya traveled to.

entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: Goblins roused into pillaging by Rogan's failed crusade.

entities.name: Jess
entities.description: Torya's younger sister, killed by goblins.

entities.name: Delly
entities.description: Torya's younger sister, killed by goblins.

events.summary: Torya, away at war, loses her family to raiding goblins.
events.quote: were all killed by raiding goblins while Torya was away in the war

events.summary: A healer bites Torya's hand and uses her blood to curse King Rogan, then is struck by a Lightning Bolt.
events.quote: using her blood to cast a curse on king Rogan

events.summary: Torya becomes Rogan's bodyguard and scrapes the monster that attacks, ending the curse.
Torya stays to help the king become a good ruler.
events.quote: She stayed to help the king become a good ruler

relations.quote: She was assigned to be a bodyguard in his chamber.
